persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a silent 9-second widescreen fact clip about Voyager 1, using NASA's mission page as the reference: https://science.nasa.gov/mission/voyager/voyager-1/ . Three equal-length scenes: 'Launched: September 5, 1977', 'Jupiter flyby: 1979', 'Saturn flyby: 1980'. Keep 'Voyager 1' and 'Source: NASA Science' visible. Show the probe near Earth, Jupiter, then Saturn; match its real dish-and-boom design. Don't mix in Voyager 2's Uranus or Neptune visits.
bank.Facts to include: Voyager 1 launched September 5, 1977, flew by Jupiter in 1979 and flew by Saturn in 1980.
bank.Length and scene order: 9 seconds total: three 3-second scenes showing Earth, Jupiter and Saturn in that order.
bank.Wording: Use exactly the five supplied labels. Keep Voyager 1 and Source: NASA Science visible throughout.
bank.Sound: Completely silent, with no narration, music or sound effects.
bank.Visual style: Your call, provided the spacecraft matches the real dish-and-boom design and the planets are recognizable.

messages.text: Please make a widescreen fact clip about Voyager 1 using NASA's mission page as the reference: https://science.nasa.gov/mission/voyager/voyager-1/ . I've always found this mission fascinating, and I'm a little worried about getting the two Voyager spacecraft mixed up when explaining it. What I have in mind is 9 seconds total, completely silent with no narration, music, or sound effects, split into three equal 3-second scenes showing the probe near Earth, then Jupiter, then Saturn. The scene labels should be exactly 'Launched: September 5, 1977', 'Jupiter flyby: 1979', and 'Saturn flyby: 1980', in that order. Please also keep the exact labels 'Voyager 1' and 'Source: NASA Science' visible throughout, so those and the three scene labels are the five supplied labels to use. The visual style is up to you as long as the planets are recognizable and the probe matches its real dish-and-boom design, and please don't mix in Voyager 2's Uranus or Neptune visits.
